title: Add, Switch Off and Delete a Rune Before Locking

steps.intent: start a Claude Bare tab on a vault, open Runes and check Lock reads Lock, so the vault is still open
press Modify, press Add Rune and add a rune the vault does not have, then check it shows in the view
press the State switch on one rune until it reads State: Off, and check the rune stays listed as off
press Delete Rune on a rune from the store, press Cancel on the notice, then press Delete Rune again and confirm with Delete
press Done and check the deleted rune is gone from the view and from Add Rune's list, and the rune I switched off still reads State: Off
